description: Delete one photo from a Stay. Call getMyStayPhotos first to find the exact fileName. Requires NOMADSTAYS_MCP_AGENT_TOKEN.

area.description: Which photo area the file belongs to (room photos aren't supported by this tool — manage those via updateStayRoom)

fileName.description: The exact file name from getMyStayPhotos, e.g. '69bdf22cdb0c43a7be3e825a0a3a2074.jpg'

name: deleteStayPhoto
